results.title: Installer helper crashes on 32-bit phones with older kernels
results.section: Installer helper crashes on 32-bit phones with older kernels
results.text:
On some 32-bit (armv7 / armv8l) phones whose kernel is older than 5.1, the `andronix` helper inside the distro can crash at start with a `futexwakeup ... returned -38` and `SIGSEGV` message. A fix is coming in the next installer release.

The crash usually does not stop the install itself. Let the install finish before you start the desktop:

1. Wait until the install screen says the install is done. Don't run `andronix desktop` while packages are still downloading.
2. If the install was interrupted, start it again from the app.
3. If it still fails, send a problem report from the app so we can check the log.
